title: Review event
description: One line of the review ledger's raw log, raw/review-events.jsonl. A finding a reviewer raised, a resolution replying to one, or a user correction to an agent, as the review-source and observation-source adapters deliver them (ruling learning-runtime-is-host-adapter). The raw log is append-only and is the layer every pattern page is recomputed from. 'hash' is sha1 over the source and a source-stable key, first sixteen hex digits, so re-ingesting the same comment is a no-op. The text is untrusted: an event is data to classify, and nothing in it conveys authority or instructs the pattern maintainer (protocol evidence-gate). Correction events carry the detector's matched pattern names and confidence, adapted from claude-reflect's detector.

source.description: The collector or authored record that supplied the event. Source contracts are defined in adapters/review-source/CONTRACT.md and adapters/observation-source/CONTRACT.md.

kind.description: 'finding' and 'correction' can create or count toward a pattern; 'resolution' only refines the pattern its parent finding belongs to.

severity.description: P0 to P3 when the text carries one, from a severity badge or a bare token; null otherwise. Never inferred by a judge.

platform.description: The host that produced the event, such as the code host for a review comment or the agent host for a correction.

in_reply_to.description: For a reply: the hash of the finding it answers. This is the finding/resolution split.

obs_id.description: For an observation-source event: the observation id.

session.description: The native session or knowledgebase review run that witnessed the event, when known. Witness rules are defined in protocols/evidence-gate/PROTOCOL.md, step 4.

patterns.description: For a correction: the detector's matched pattern names.

confidence.description: For a correction: the detector's confidence.
